title: Gemini Connector Strategy & Agent Development Framework
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Govern the connectors and agents before they multiply
problem: Gemini's value comes from connectors to enterprise data and agents that act — and both are risk surfaces if they're built ad hoc. This solution defines the connector strategy and agent-development framework for Gemini Enterprise: which connectors are approved and how data-access boundaries apply, and a governed framework for building agentic workflows safely — so AI capability expands without creating an ungoverned sprawl, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the connector + agent governance model: how connectors expose data, where boundaries apply, and the guardrails for agent development.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (Gemini Enterprise, the data-governance baseline, security/legal alignment, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.

Connector Strategy & Agent Framework — the approval criteria and data-access boundaries for connectors, and the standard framework/guardrails for developing agentic workflows (design, review, deploy, monitor).
5 supporting scripts — connector/agent inventory discovery, boundary/guardrail conformance validation, a connector/agent coverage-and-risk report, safe remediation, and a scope helper.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides plus Best Practices for governed AI expansion; preview capabilities cited or flagged, never invented.
short: Define the connector strategy and agent-development framework for Gemini Enterprise — approved connectors with data-access boundaries and governed agentic-workflow development — so AI expands without ungoverned sprawl, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
